##### Project general facts

Aura Elite by Aura Infinite Real Estate Development is a contemporary residential building that combines restrained architecture, functional layouts and a comfortable environment for everyday life. A modern minimalist exterior with clean geometric lines, panoramic glazing and neat balconies creates an elegant architectural image. The building rises from a ground floor to nine residential floors, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including an additional room for a study or home office.

Amenities focus on everyday comfort and wellbeing. Residents enjoy a swimming pool with relaxation areas, a fully equipped gym and a children's play area, while a stylish lobby welcomes residents and guests. Dining outlets at ground level add convenience, and the shared spaces are designed with an emphasis on functionality, calm and social interaction, creating a pleasant setting for families, couples and professionals who value a practical and well-connected address.

Layouts are designed for convenience and efficient use of space, with spacious living areas, large windows and balconies that bring in plenty of natural light. Interiors follow a light neutral palette with modern materials and clean, understated design solutions. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is an integrated technology park and residential community in eastern Dubai, combining offices, research facilities, universities and residential neighbourhoods within a single free zone. Landscaped parks, jogging tracks, Silicon Central Mall, supermarkets, schools and clinics create a calm, family-friendly setting where everyday needs are close to home and many residents can live near their workplace.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city. Dubai Academic City, Dragon Mart and City Centre Mirdif are a short drive away, Global Village and Dubai Outlet Mall are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach for work, study and travel.

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most established mid-market residential addresses in Dubai. A concentration of technology companies and universities supports steady demand from professionals and students. Competitive prices, a mature community and strong road links underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
